name: Marvel Comics API
tagline: Official Marvel comics, characters, series, and events catalog with image assets
description: The Marvel Comics API provides programmatic access to Marvel's official catalog of comics, characters, series, events, stories, and creators, including image assets and metadata for building comic-related applications and experiences.

auth.details: Public and private API keys; requests require ts, apikey, and hash (MD5 of ts+privateKey+publicKey) as query parameters

rate_limits: 3,000 calls/day (free tier); higher limits may require contact
use_cases: look up a Marvel character by name
fetch character or comic cover images
